verdict.rationale: Groq's docs say its Responses API supports remote tool use through MCP servers. You provide an MCP server URL and authentication, and Groq handles all tool orchestration without you implementing any tool logic. That directly delivers plugging MCP servers in so the product can use their tools. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP integration works in practice, and evidence of support beyond remote HTTPS servers (e.g., local/stdio servers or support outside the Responses API).
